name: Survival Ark
storyline:
The SEV virus has nearly destroyed a remote island, transforming its inhabitants and wildlife into dangerous infected creatures. When the player awakens on the plague island, they discover that civilization has collapsed and the island is filled with zombies, mutated animals and other threats.

With food, water and other resources becoming scarce, survival depends on exploration, scavenging and careful preparation. The player must gather materials, craft weapons, armor and supplies, and construct a fortified shelter known as the Survival Ark.

The island is more than a place to survive. As the player explores its towns, wilderness and dangerous areas, they encounter clues about the origin of the plague and the people behind the disaster. Progressing through the story gradually reveals more about what happened to the island and whether the outbreak can be stopped before it spreads beyond it.
summary:
Survival Ark is a single-player survival adventure set on a plague-infected island after the spread of the mysterious SEV virus. As the sole surviving outsider, the player must explore the island, gather resources, craft equipment, fight infected creatures and uncover the cause of the disaster.

Survival revolves around scavenging food, water and materials, crafting weapons, armor and other necessities, and establishing a fortified shelter known as the Survival Ark. The island is populated by mutated wildlife, zombies and other dangerous creatures, requiring different weapons and strategies to overcome its threats.

Beyond survival and combat, the game follows a story-driven exploration of the island, with missions and discoveries gradually revealing more about the plague and the people connected to the disaster. The game is designed as an offline experience and uses a bird's-eye view to present its world and combat.
